title: Hand off more than an assignment.
summary: Give the next agent a brief, its background, and a way to signal that the work is ready for review.
situation: An agent needs to add session expiry without interrupting checkout. Give it a brief linked to the security decision and checkout constraint.

steps.title: Prepare the brief.
steps.body: Record the goal, review criteria, and links to the relevant decisions.

steps.title: Record progress.
steps.body: The working agent adds findings and updates the brief’s status tag.

steps.title: Review with context.
steps.body: The coordinating agent retrieves the result and its supporting context.

sample.label: Example brief
sample.text: Add session expiry. Preserve active checkout sessions. Explain the implementation and record any unresolved questions.

transition.label: An example status convention
transition.description: The working agent replaces the in-progress tag when its findings are ready. The coordinating agent checks for review-ready work.

boundary: Status tags are conventions, not automation. Your agents handle delegation, updates, status checks, and review.

title: Keep the reason behind the code.
summary: Link a decision to the code it explains.
situation: A checkout exception looks safe to remove. The linked decision explains why active payments need it.

steps.title: Save the reason.
steps.body: Record the session policy and the checkout constraint.

steps.title: Link it to the code.
steps.body: Connect the decision to the session-handling code reference.

steps.title: Use it in review.
steps.body: Retrieve the decision before changing session handling.

sample.label: Example decision
sample.text: Inactive sessions expire after 30 minutes. An active checkout must not lose its session partway through payment.

boundary: People or agents must record and maintain these links. Check that the decision still applies before relying on it.

title: Pick up the thread without starting over.
summary: Save what you found and what to check next.
situation: The debugging session ends before the bug is fixed. Save what you learned so the next session has a starting point.

steps.title: Save the findings.
steps.body: Note what you observed, ruled out, and still need to check.

steps.title: Link the background.
steps.body: Attach the relevant policy and code reference.

steps.title: Resume with a question.
steps.body: Retrieve the note and give your agent the next thing to investigate.

sample.label: Example working note
sample.text: The timeout only appears when checkout remains open. Token refresh succeeds. Still to check: when the checkout marks the session active.

boundary: Notes must be saved and retrieved explicitly. AeroGraph does not capture chats or resume agent sessions automatically.
takeaway: Preserve the useful result of a session, not every line of the conversation.
